description: One-way fixed-size fingerprint of data. Same input, same digest. For integrity and cache keys, not for passwords.
A hash keyed with a secret: only key holders can produce a valid signature. Used to sign webhooks and tokens.
Compares two equal-length buffers in constant time so timing does not leak how much matched. Throws on different lengths.
Guessing a secret by measuring how long comparisons take; `===` returns faster on an early mismatch.
Cryptographically secure random values for tokens and ids. `Math.random()` is predictable.
The exact bytes received. Webhook signatures are computed over it, not over re-serialized JSON.
